message:
So the flow is: the fuzzer sends an IPv6 packet that is a CoAP "Server Data" message (network data registration). This gets handled by `HandleServerData`, which extracts a `ThreadNetworkDataTlv` and calls `RegisterNetworkData`, which calls `AddNetworkData`, which processes the Prefix TLV containing a HasRoute TLV with 0 entries, causing the OOB read.

Let me look at the CoAP URI path for this handler and understand the message format.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "kUriServerData\|HandleServerData\|ServerData" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread/src/core/thread/network_data_leader_ftd.cpp | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
